regions.merged_text: Thanks - John Paspyhala - 48 - Thankful for fearful experiences - Arthritis, estraordinary skin and nail eruption - Given up as hope- lessly incurable - still carries certificate from Ann Arbor Hospital that even though his skin trouble was incurable, "it is neither con- tageous or infectious" Says he never imagined a human being could stand so much and live - must have been a sight without a spear of hair on his head .... His Dr. ( Zimmer) urged him to say the rosary to our Bl. Mother. .his mother came again and again asking prayers and Enrolling him in the Ser. Masses. Now like a second Holy Job says - the experience was beyond price ... would not have missed it for a million dollars ... but would go through it again for ten millions. Lives now at 8918 Helen Ave. Aug. 18, '42 Here again To-day says cure "Miraculous"
